summary: Iteration 46 full E2E pass: Partners (labour/subcontractor), Ecommerce, ProjectPartnerCard (new this session), reports, CEO dashboard, T&C PDF linkage and RBAC. Backend: created /app/backend/tests/test_iter46_partners_ecommerce.py — 38/38 pytest tests pass (partner CRUD + rate-card versioning, assignment pricing gross=qty*rate & retention=pct, by-project endpoint, payments + account_entries ledger posting, retention-release DISCOM block, ecommerce platform/listing/order, order total/commission/net_payout math, stock decrement, return restore + no double-restore, insufficient-stock & duplicate-order guards, reconciliation, partner_performance + ecommerce reports, CEO ecommerce section, T&C per-category active switching, RBAC 403 for staff & 401 anon). Frontend: exercised PartnersPage onboarding, PartnerDetail (4 tabs, assignment, payment, retention block with correct DISCOM error), ProjectPartnerCard inline assign (works, data shared with PartnerDetail), EcommercePage (platform/listing/order + stock -2 verified via /api/inventory/items, reconciliation tab), Reports, CEO dashboard, Kit Quotation + GST Invoice (Combined & List) PDF downloads. Found 1 CRITICAL frontend crash (Ecommerce report), 1 blocking bug I fixed (projectsAPI.list), 1 HIGH functional gap (no UI to cancel/return an ecommerce order) and 1 security review item on /auth/register.

minor.issue: summary.listing_status is a nested dict {live, delisted, draft}. Every other report returns scalar summary values; ReportsPage renders summary entries directly, so this object crashes the UI (see frontend critical). Flatten to e.g. listings_live/listings_draft/listings_delisted or move out of `summary`.

_decrement_stock(db, lines, None, ...) is called BEFORE insert_one, so every inventory_movements row for an ecommerce sale has reference_id=null — the stock movement cannot be traced back to the order (restore path does pass order_id). Insert order first (or update movements with the new id).

Open endpoint accepts an arbitrary `role` in the payload (self-elevation to admin possible) AND sets access/refresh cookies for the newly created user. An authenticated admin calling it is silently switched into the new user's session (reproduced: subsequent admin-only DELETEs returned 403). Pre-existing, not iteration 46, but security-relevant.
Orders belonging to archived (active=false) platforms are still listed; platform_name resolves fine but there is no way to filter them out. Cosmetic.

ui_bugs.issue: CRITICAL: clicking the Ecommerce report card white-screens the whole Reports page with 'Uncaught runtime error: Objects are not valid as a React child (found: object with keys {live, delisted, draft})'. RCA: ReportsPage.js:269 maps Object.entries(reportData.summary) into <SummaryCard value={formatSummaryValue(k,v)}/> and formatSummaryValue does not handle object values; backend returns summary.listing_status as a dict. Fix either side (flatten backend OR guard formatSummaryValue for non-primitives).

FIXED BY TESTER: openAssign called projectsAPI.list({status:'approved'}) which does not exist on the api client -> 'projectsAPI.list is not a function', project dropdown was permanently empty and NO assignment could ever be created from the standalone Partners module. Changed to projectsAPI.getAll('approved'). Please review/keep this fix.

HIGH: the Orders table is read-only — zero buttons/selects per row. There is no UI to change order_status to cancelled/returned or to record settlement, so the (working) backend stock-restore path is unreachable from the app. Requirement 'cancelling/returning an order restores stock' can only be exercised via API.

Retention-release failure is surfaced with window.alert() and the assign/payment dialogs use an inline red div; the rest of the app uses toasts. Behaviourally correct (the DISCOM 400 message does reach the user) but inconsistent UX and not assertable via a data-testid.
Partner cards are clickable <Card onClick> divs with no role/tabIndex — not keyboard reachable. data-testid=partner-card-{id} exists, so tests are fine; accessibility only.

integration_issues.flow: Project Details → Profit Calculator vs partner assignments
integration_issues.issue: Project 6a988dfe68af754c83aadaad has 3 partner assignments totalling ₹26,000 gross, but the Profit Calculator card still shows 'Labour/Subcontractor ₹0'. Partner assignment cost does not feed the project profit calculation, so project margin is overstated once labour is subcontracted. Confirm whether this is intended (manual field) or a missing wire-up.

The currently ACTIVE invoice T&C template is 'TEST_Invoice_Terms_384fa' (v5) — leftover test data from earlier iterations; 4 of 5 invoice templates are TEST_*. Real GST invoices generated today would embed test clauses. Recommend deleting TEST_* terms and re-activating 'Standard Invoice Terms'.

Repeated React warning 'Encountered two children with the same key, %s' while rendering the CEO dashboard (duplicate keys in one of the mapped lists) — cosmetic but should be fixed.

Category filter chips (All/Quotation/Invoice/AMC) + per-row 'Set Active' present and correct; category badge shown per template.

HIGH: Add order-status actions (cancel / return / settle) to the EcommercePage Orders tab so the backend stock-restore path is reachable from the UI.

Set reference_id on ecommerce sale inventory_movements (insert the order before decrementing stock).
Security: restrict role in POST /api/auth/register (or require admin) and stop setting session cookies when an admin creates a user.
Decide whether partner assignment gross should feed the project Profit Calculator 'Labour/Subcontractor' figure.

critical_code_review_comments: reports/ecommerce returns a nested dict inside `summary` while every other report returns scalars — the shared renderer has no defensive guard; this contract mismatch is the root cause of the white-screen.
ecommerce.create_order decrements stock before persisting the order, leaving orphan inventory_movements (reference_id=null) if the insert or a later validation fails — no transaction/compensation.

PartnerDetail.js and ProjectPartnerCard.js duplicate ~40 lines of assign-dialog logic (activityOptions/toggleActivity/updateActivityQty/scope-hint suggestion). Extract a shared hook to avoid divergence.
Error surfacing in PartnerDetail uses window.alert(); no data-testid on the error, making regressions hard to assert.
partners.py list_partners runs an N+1 aggregate (_partner_stats does 2 queries per partner) — fine at current volume, will not scale past a few hundred partners.

rca_of_the_issue: 1) Ecommerce report crash: GET /api/reports/ecommerce returns summary.listing_status as a Counter->dict; ReportsPage.js:269 iterates Object.entries(reportData.summary) and passes each value to <SummaryCard value=...> via formatSummaryValue, which only handles numbers/strings, so React receives a plain object as a child and throws 'Objects are not valid as a React child', unmounting the whole Reports route. 2) PartnerDetail assign dialog: openAssign called projectsAPI.list(), a method that does not exist on utils/api.js's projectsAPI (only getAll/getOne/...), so the promise rejected, the catch only console.error'd, and `projects` stayed [] — the Project select rendered zero options and no assignment could be created; replaced with projectsAPI.getAll('approved') and the whole flow (gross ₹10,000, retention ₹1,000, ₹3,000 advance -> balance ₹7,000, DISCOM-gated retention block) then verified end-to-end. 3) Ecommerce return/cancel: backend PUT /api/ecommerce/orders/{id} correctly restores stock exactly once (verified: 100 -> 98 -> 100, repeat return does not double-restore), but the Orders table renders no interactive control, so the flow is UI-unreachable.
